CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Deckle** builds a morning newspaper for your e-reader from your town's news and weather, your RSS feeds and the articles you saved: a front page, sections, a puzzle, and a last page you can finish.
The container here is the headless Deckle. It builds the paper on your schedule, keeps every edition in a Morgue folder, and sends it to a Kindle by email, to KOReader over Wi-Fi, or to any folder. The Deckle app runs in your browser on port 8080.
Deckle is free and open source (GPL-3.0). Kindle book conversion needs Kindle Previewer, so it stays in the Mac and Windows app.
Support: https://github.com/CasaVargas/deckle/issues
